note: Relay list for NovaGram WSS transport. Bump `version` on every change; clients ignore a lower one. `official` is tried first, then `own` in order, then `fronts` (rotated). {dc} = data centre number, {media} = '-1' for media connections on the official relay. `ips` pins an address per data centre; without it the name is resolved over DoH.
